issues.issue: N is stated as 163 (the crizotinib-pretreated efficacy population), but the key_safety field and design/phase citations reference 255 patients at 750 mg; the safety denominator N=255 differs and the trial's total differs — the single 'n' value conflates distinct populations and should be reconciled.

Text asserts the efficacy cohort was 'drawn from patients treated at the 750 mg recommended dose (escalation and expansion phases)' with 255 at 750 mg, but the efficacy/design citations consistently describe 163 efficacy patients; the 255 figure (safety) is mixed into the efficacy phase description, creating internal inconsistency.

The safety AE rates (diarrhea 86%, nausea 80%, vomiting 60%, fatigue 52%) are drawn from the N=255 population while the pivotal trial n is 163; this is supportable by citation but the population mismatch should be flagged as a potential reader confusion between efficacy (163) and safety (255) cohorts.
